summary: Extends the PIDF-LO location format (RFC 4119) so location can be described relative to a reference point, which may itself be geodetic or civic, using one of several shapes for the offset. It also describes a binary form and an optional link to a map image.

eli5.summary: Instead of an address, you say go three steps north of the big tree. It is a way to write that down.

questions: how to express location relative to a point
